visual.description: Centered headline spanning ~80% width with subtitle below it, single CTA button, then a product screenshot mockup at the bottom half bleeding off-screen — text above, image below, no columns.
Product UI screenshot occupies left ~65% of viewport while a second image (blue-tinted photo) occupies right ~35%, both inside a rounded card frame that bleeds off screen.
Single centered text block spanning ~60% width with a large paragraph statement, no columns, no images — pure typographic section on a gradient background.
8 company logos arranged in 2 rows of 4 equal columns on a dark-to-purple gradient background, preceded by a centered label line.
Left ~45% contains a vertically stacked list of 3 feature items with left-border accent on the active one; right ~55% shows a mobile app screenshot on a solid blue background card.
Four feature tiles in a 2-column, 2-row equal grid, each containing a feature name, short description, and a product screenshot card with a colored background.
Three feature tiles in a single row of 3 equal columns, each with a headline, short description, and a partial app screenshot card visible at the bottom — cards bleed off the bottom edge.
Left-aligned icon mark, large 2-line headline in white with a muted secondary line below it, occupying approximately the left 50% of the viewport with large empty right space.
Three items centered horizontally — two laurel-wreath award badges flanking a central Product Hunt logo image — forming a loose 3-column symmetrical grouping.
Single column of large centered text items, each feature name stacked vertically with decreasing opacity from top to bottom, creating a fade-out scroll effect.
One large centered block quote in pixel/retro font with multi-color word highlights, source attribution below it, on a near-black background — no columns.
Three columns of testimonial cards with varied heights (masonry-style), cards having no background fill — just bordered or floating text blocks on a dark background.
Five labeled columns (Company, App, Use Cases, Social, Updates) with the rightmost column containing a versioned update card instead of a link list, all on a near-black background.
